**Why it was a problem:** Every frontend module's remote entry embedded its own copy of `@module-federation/runtime-core`. The copies were identical, so each app made the browser download the same runtime again. The changeset measures `@openmrs/esm-login-app`'s production remote entry dropping from ~85 kB to ~32 kB raw (~26 kB to ~9.7 kB gzipped), and the PR says the runtime was ~85 kB of each app's initial chunk. About 14 kB of `@module-federation/runtime` and `webpack-bundler-runtime` stays per remote because they cache a federation instance at module scope, so sharing them would break re-initialization (RUNTIME-010). (`.changeset/mf-runtime-shipped-once.md`, `packages/tooling/rspack-config/src/index.ts:527-530`)

**What the app shell does now:**
- At startup, `packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/index.ts` calls `publishFederationRuntime()`. That function, in `packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/federation-runtime.ts:30-42`, puts `@module-federation/sdk` and `@module-federation/error-codes` on globals (`_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_SDK`, `_OPENMRS_FEDERATION_ERROR_CODES`). It logs an error if `_FEDERATION_RUNTIME_CORE` is missing.
- The shell's rspack config sets `experiments.provideExternalRuntime: true`, which publishes `runtime-core` as `_FEDERATION_RUNTIME_CORE` (`packages/shell/esm-app-shell/rspack.config.js:492-496`).
- Remotes built by `@openmrs/rspack-config` set `experiments.externalRuntime: true` (`packages/tooling/rspack-config/src/index.ts:471-480`). They also add an `ExternalsPlugin('global', ...)` that reads the SDK and error codes from those globals (lines 539-542). `packages/tooling/webpack-config/src/index.ts` does the same on the webpack side.
- A remote that finds no runtime fails with a banner saying the app shell is too old (`packages/tooling/rspack-config/src/index.ts:84`, `packages/tooling/webpack-config/src/index.ts:112`).
- For backward compatibility, `packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/federation-plugins.ts:57-66` (`asResolvedShare`) makes resolver return values work with both the 0.x and 2.x runtime contracts. Older apps that still embed their own runtime keep working under the new shell.

**Which change:** Commit `04f538d18519df68de61dd0b076084b85dfb358d`, "(feat) Federate most of the Module Federation runtime (#1853)", merged 2026-08-27. The PR is #1853, and the ticket is O3-5873. The commit subject doesn't name the ticket; Falkon links it through the PR and the changeset title.

Related but not the answer: commit `f621a02d06bee0819e6fe3faaab656369511e632` pinned rspack to `~1.3.x` so remotes stay compatible with the pre-built app shell's Module Federation runtime. It isn't part of this change.
